coverage.scope: All defined ASCII-labelled English affix records in the complete cached Wiktionary snapshot, plus all defined Greek/Latin root table rows and five independently checked blank-row supplements. Three remaining blank table rows already occur as variants in defined groups. Source records preserve homonymous etymologies; totals are entries and senses, not a claim of this many unique families in English.

senses.ko: 어근이 나타내는 같은 종류의 연속된 두 사건 사이의 시간적 위치

senses.en: A position which is in between two (or more) of the kind indicated by the root. A spatial position which is in between two adjacent landmarks of the kind indicated by the root.

senses.ko: 기본 말이 가리키는 지점과 명시되지 않은 기준점 사이의 공간적 위치

senses.en: Mutually: the root verb or property has a symmetric and bidirectional relationship between the relevant parties.
senses.ko: 서로; 관련 당사자 사이에서 동작이나 속성이 대칭적이고 양방향임을 나타냄

senses.en: Combining together: the root verb is done together, generally uniting or merging multiple objects.
senses.ko: 함께 결합하여; 여러 대상을 합치며 함께 행함

senses.en: Hybrid: combining two or more of the root together to produce a hybrid.
senses.ko: 둘 이상의 대상을 결합하여 혼합체를 이룸

senses.en: Internally: the root verb is done in between or among relevant entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form.

senses.en: Internally: the root verb is done in between or among relevant entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form. Interspatially: the root verb is done between or among spatial entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form.

senses.en: Internally: the root verb is done in between or among relevant entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form. Intersocially: the root verb is done between or among social entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form.
senses.ko: 사회적 주체들 사이에서 동작이 이루어짐. 이 동사에서 파생한 명사·형용사도 만든다.

senses.en: Internally: the root verb is done in between or among relevant entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form. Intermittently: the root verb is done between or among temporal entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form.
senses.ko: 관련 대상들 사이에서 또는 시간적 간격을 두고 행위가 이루어짐을 나타내며, 파생 명사·형용사도 만듦

senses.en: Internally: the root verb is done in between or among relevant entities; also forming nouns and adjectives derived from the verb form. Transferable: the root entity is or can be transferred between multiple locales.
senses.ko: 관련 대상 사이에서 이루어지는 작용; 특히 여러 장소 사이에서 옮길 수 있음을 나타냄

senses.en: Alternating: a sequence of alternating kinds of the root.
senses.ko: 서로 다른 종류가 번갈아 나타나는 순서

senses.en: Link: to connect multiple kinds of the root.
Link: to connect multiple kinds of the root. Abutment: to connect multiple spatial regions of the type indicated by the root.

senses.en: Link: to connect multiple kinds of the root. Cooperating: to connect multiple social entities of the type indicated by the root.

senses.en: Involving multiple of the root. Universal or independent of the root social groups or time periods.

senses.en: Intermediate between multiple of the type indicated by the root. Inserting between multiple entities of the kind indicated by the root.

third-person singular simple present indicative of -ise

senses.ko: 동사에 붙여 '~하는 경향이 있는'이라는 형용사를 만듦

senses.en: Added to adjectives to form informal synonyms or adjectives meaning "somewhat, rather".
senses.ko: 형용사에 붙여 비격식 동의어나 다소·꽤 ~하다는 뜻의 형용사를 만든다.

senses.en: Denotes the infinitive of verbs when used intransitively.
senses.ko: 자동사로 쓰일 때 동사의 부정형을 나타냄

senses.en: Forming abstract nouns denoting a condition, quality, or state.
Used in the name of some locations which end in -ia in Latin.
Agent suffix, equivalent to -er, appended to some nouns (especially those ending in the letter "w" or "v").
senses.ko: 일부 명사, 특히 w·v로 끝나는 명사에 붙는 -er와 같은 행위자 접미사

senses.en: Belonging to the day preceding the present; next before the present.
senses.ko: 현재의 전날에 속하는; 현재 바로 이전의

senses.en: Of former, earlier, or previous times.
A univalent radical or functional group formed from a given molecule. Thus propyl from propane, benzyl from benzene, and so forth.
senses.ko: 분자에서 생긴 1가 라디칼·작용기. 예: propane에서 propyl, benzene에서 benzyl

senses.en: used to form the names of bivalent radicals
Bivalent radical derived especially from a saturated hydrocarbon by removal of two hydrogen atoms from the same carbon atom or the removal of the oxygen atom of an aldehyde.
senses.ko: 특히 포화 탄화수소의 같은 탄소에서 수소 둘을 제거하거나 알데하이드에서 산소를 제거하여 얻는 이가 원자단

senses.en: An unsaturated hydrocarbon having at least one triple bond; an alkyne.
senses.ko: 삼중결합을 하나 이상 가진 불포화 탄화수소; 알카인

senses.en: A polymer derived from an alkyne.
In the International System of Units and other metric systems of units, multiplying the unit to which it is attached by 10⁻²⁴ short scale septillionth or long scale quadrillionth).

senses.en: In the International System of Units and other metric systems of units, multiplying the unit to which it is attached by 10²⁴ (a short scale septillion or long scale quadrillion). Symbol: Y
senses.ko: 국제단위계와 다른 미터법에서 단위의 10²⁴배를 나타냄. 기호: Y

senses.en: Pertaining to Yugoslavia or the Yugoslavs.
Forms nicknames, especially of personal names.
senses.ko: 특히 사람 이름의 별명이나 애칭을 만든다.

senses.en: Used as a substitute for -s in marking the plural of nouns. Usually used in words in which the -s suffix is actually pronounced /z/.
senses.ko: 명사 복수형의 -s를 대신함. 보통 -s가 /z/로 발음되는 단어에 쓰임

senses.en: The IEC prefix meaning 2⁷⁰ = 1,024⁷ = 1,180,591,620,717,411,303,424. Compare zetta-, meaning 10²¹ = 1,000⁷ = 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000, a sextillion.
senses.ko: 국제전기기술위원회 접두사로 2⁷⁰ = 1,024⁷ = 1,180,591,620,717,411,303,424를 뜻함. 10²¹배를 뜻하는 zetta-와 비교

senses.en: Used to form names of tricyclic compounds used as antidepressants/neuroleptics, antiulcers, anticonvulsants, or for hyperthermia.
senses.ko: 항우울제·신경이완제·항궤양제·항경련제 또는 고체온 관련 용도로 쓰이는 삼환 화합물의 이름을 만듦

senses.en: In the International System of Units and other metric systems of units, multiplying the unit to which it is attached by 10⁻²¹ (short scale sextillionth or long scale trilliardth).
In the International System of Units and other metric systems of units, multiplying the unit to which it is attached by 10²¹ (a short scale sextillion or long scale trilliard).
senses.ko: 국제단위계 등 미터법에서 뒤에 오는 단위를 10²¹배로 한다.

senses.en: Like Godzilla; monstrous, destructive, massive, powerful, wild.
senses.ko: 고질라 같은; 괴물 같은, 파괴적인, 거대한, 강력한, 사나운

senses.ko: 아연을 포함하거나 아연과 결합하거나 아연을 사용하는

senses.en: Used to categorise animals based on their evolutionary origin, life history, growth-form or ecological preferences.
senses.ko: 동물의 진화적 기원·생활사·성장 형태·생태적 선호에 따라 분류하는 데 쓴다.

examples: protozoan a member of the Protozoa
scyphozoan a member of the Scyphozoa

senses.en: Relating to some specified form of animal existence
Relating to some specified geologic period

senses.ko: 감염성 포자와 그 생활 단계의 이름을 만듦

senses.en: Used to form names of anti-inflammatory agents.
Forming nouns indicating individual members of taxonomic groups whose names end in -zoa.
senses.ko: -zoa로 끝나는 분류군의 개체를 나타내는 명사를 만든다.

senses.en: Forming nouns indicating organisms have a particular specified way of life.
senses.ko: 특정 생활 방식을 가진 생물을 나타내는 명사를 만듦

senses.en: Having a specified state of physical pairing of structures.
Alternative form of zymo- (before a vowel).
